title: Signal-fusion triage for hosted chat, streaming, tool-calls, and structured-output requests
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: Enterprise customers submit feature asks for hosted chat streaming, function/tool calls, and structured outputs with inconsistent signals (legal/regulatory notes, product ROI, latency/SLO needs, and implementation cost). Current intake decisions are slow, inconsistent across PMs, and cause backlog churn and missed SLAs. Goal: Define a reproducible, evidence-weighted triage workflow ("signal-fusion") and a short rubric PMs use to score, prioritize, and route enterprise-hosted API feature requests. The outcome should reduce decision time, increase predictability for customers (SLA response times), and provide clear routing to Dedicated/Private offerings or engineering spike work.
acceptance_criteria: A 6-factor scoring rubric (weights documented) exists and is accessible in Confluence
Triage playbook with decision thresholds for: immediate intake (P0/P1), scheduled backlog, security review, and Dedicated/Private routing is approved by Eng and Security
Two weeks of shadowing: PMs use the rubric on all incoming enterprise hosted-API feature requests and we log scores -> target inter-rater agreement (Cohen's kappa) >= 0.6
Automation checklist created for the intake form (customer-facing) to capture necessary signals: SLA, regulatory, contract value, expected qps/throughput, data sensitivity
Dashboards: an intake queue with signal breakdowns and median time-to-decision is added to the PM console (operate by Growth/Platform PMs)
Pilot triage on 20 incoming requests with documented routing outcomes and post-mortem lessons
rubric: Proposed signals and example weights (final percentages to be validated during pilot):
1) Customer business impact (revenue/strategic): 25% - Quantized: strategic (100), high-revenue (75), medium (40), low (0)
2) SLO/Urgency (latency/availability needs): 20% - Hard blocker SLA vs enhancement
3) Security/Compliance & Data Sensitivity: 20% - Requires Private/Dedicated or KMS/HSM integration -> escalate to Security review
4) Implementation complexity & cross-team dependencies: 15% - quick config vs multi-week runtime change
5) Product fit & Reusability: 10% - one-off tenant vs platform-level capability
6) Measured usage signal or forecasted QPS/cost delta: 10% - informed by customer telemetry or sales estimates
Scoring: each signal scored 0-100, multiplied by weight, sum -> priority bucket mappings (>=75 P0/P1 fast track; 50-75 scheduled in next cycle; <50 backlog/PRD request)
Notes: security flag forces immediate holding state and parallel security review regardless of score

decisions: Adopt signal-fusion scoring as the canonical triage mechanism for enterprise hosted-API feature requests
Security reviews are required for any request scoring > 60 on 'Data Sensitivity' or explicitly requesting Private deployment
Requests routed to Dedicated will include an estimated cost delta and proposed autoscaling profile from Engineering before approval
